$comment: The monorepo's areas: the ONE hand-written list (root AGENTS.md 영역 지도). Every script that needs the set reads this file. scripts/guard/area-registry.sh refuses a tracked file that names all areas but one or more by hand, and the xtask test `areas_match_the_registry` refuses an xtask area table that disagrees. `slug` is the `cargo xtask verify` name, `dir` the path from the repository root, `title` the owner name in the document inventory. One object per line: xtask is std-only and reads these lines without a JSON parser.
